name: Brian Evanko

career.title: Actuarial Executive Development Program, then senior actuarial and finance roles incl. in Singapore and Hong Kong
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (also President and CEO of Cigna Healthcare from 2024)

background_rationale: A credentialed actuary (FSA) and CFA charterholder who came up through Cigna's actuarial and finance ranks and served as CFO for four years before becoming COO and CEO.

notable.summary: On being named CEO-designate, Evanko thanked predecessor David Cordani for his mentorship and said that over nearly 30 years at the company he had seen the strength of its businesses and its commitment to customers.

In his first quarterly results as CEO, Cigna reported Q2 2026 revenue of $71.7 billion, up 7%, and raised its 2026 outlook, with Evanko citing technology, data and AI as drivers of more personalized, lower-cost care.

At Cigna's 2026 Investor Day, introduced the "Lead to One" strategy and a multi-year, $3 billion modernization and productivity initiative, along with 2026-2030 targets of 10-14% annual adjusted EPS growth.

personal_story.hook: Brian Evanko joined Cigna in 1998 through its actuarial development program and became CEO 28 years later.
personal_story.summary: Evanko studied actuarial science at Penn State and joined Cigna in 1998 through its Actuarial Executive Development Program, which he later led. He held actuarial and finance roles in Singapore and Hong Kong, then ran Cigna's U.S. individual and government businesses before serving as CFO from 2021. He became CEO on July 1, 2026, succeeding longtime chief David Cordani, and has said that following "a legend" adds pressure that helps him perform.
